name: autobizdevops-plugin-kanban
description: Kanban-driven AutobizDevOps workflow plugin for requirement discussion, development, testing, CI/CD, and archive flows.

interface.shortDescription: Run AutobizDevOps feature workflows from a kanban state machine.
interface.longDescription: AutobizDevOps Kanban provides local skills, workflow state scripts, hooks, and MCP configuration for progressing a feature through requirement discussion, PRD generation, specs, planning, coding, review, tests, verification, CI/CD, and archive stages.
defaultPrompt: Start a new AutobizDevOps feature workflow.
Show the current kanban checkpoint and next skill.
Continue this feature through the next AutobizDevOps stage.
